notes.title: Patch 0.2.0 available (Question overhaul, Cloud Save, Achievements)
notes.content:
The following content has been changed or added:

- Cloud Saves have been enabled, but are still being tested on the live server.
- Achievements added.
- The majority of over 1000 questions have been revised.

notes.title: Der Fachinformatiker-Trainer
notes.content:
Get ready for your final exam Part 1 (AP1) in the best possible way! The IT Specialist Trainer is your free companion on the road to success. With over 1,000 questions, sorted by category or available as random questions, you can effectively test your knowledge and close any gaps.

✅ Perfectly tailored to the AP1 – focus on exam-relevant topics
✅ Over 1,000 questions – sorted by topics or in random mode
✅ Effective exam preparation – quickly identify strengths & weaknesses
✅ Flexible learning – practice anytime, anywhere

📢 Be ready for the AP1 at the end of March! Starting February 28, 2025, you can get started. 🎯
